xna-type.name: GamePadState
xna-type.summary: Represents specific information about the state of an Xbox 360 Controller, including the current state of buttons and sticks.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the GamePadState class with the specified stick, trigger, and button values.
constructor.syntax: 'Declaration Public Sub New ( _ leftThumbStick As Vector2, _ rightThumbStick As Vector2, _ leftTrigger As Single, _ rightTrigger As Single, _ buttons As Buttons() _ )

parameters.parameter: Type: Vector2 Left stick value. Each axis is clamped between −1.0 and 1.0.
Type: Vector2 Right stick value. Each axis is clamped between −1.0 and 1.0.
Type: Single Left trigger value. This value is clamped between 0.0 and 1.0.
Type: Single Right trigger value. This value is clamped between 0.0 and 1.0.
Type: Buttons Array or parameter list of Buttons to initialize as pressed.

constructor.remarks: Games normally use GetState to get the true gamepad state. This constructor is used instead to simulate gamepad input for passing within the game's own input subsystem.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the GamePadState class using the specified GamePadThumbSticks, GamePadTriggers, GamePadButtons, and GamePadDPad.
constructor.syntax: 'Declaration Public Sub New ( _ thumbSticks As GamePadThumbSticks, _ triggers As GamePadTriggers, _ buttons As GamePadButtons, _ dPad As GamePadDPad _ )

parameters.parameter: Type: GamePadDPad Initial directional pad state.

constructor.remarks: Games normally use GetState to get the true gamepad state. This constructor is used instead to simulate gamepad input for passing within the game's own input subsystem. Thumbstick state is different from the state indicated by the GamePadButtons.LeftStick Property or the GamePadButtons.RightStick Property . Thumbstick state refers to the position of the thumbstick, while the LeftStick or RightStick properties indicate if the stick is "clicked" in.

property.name: Buttons
property.summary: Returns a structure that identifies what buttons on the Xbox 360 Controller are pressed.

property.name: DPad
property.summary: Returns a structure that identifies what directions of the directional pad on the Xbox 360 Controller are pressed.

property.name: IsConnected
property.summary: Indicates whether the Xbox 360 Controller is connected.
property.remarks: When calling GetState or GetCapabilities , check the returned structure's IsConnected property value. If the controller has been disconnected, this value will be false . When a controller is disconnected, values for its state and/or capabilities will not be valid. The controller will also not be able to receive new vibration settings.

property.name: PacketNumber
property.summary: Gets the packet number associated with this state.
property.remarks: You can use PacketNumber to determine whether input state has changed. If the value of PacketNumber remains the same between two sequential calls to GetState , then there has been no change in input.

property.name: ThumbSticks
property.summary: Returns a structure that indicates the position of the Xbox 360 Controller sticks (thumbsticks).

property.name: Triggers
property.summary: Returns a structure that identifies the position of triggers on the Xbox 360 Controller.

method.name: IsButtonDown
method.summary: Determines whether specified input device buttons are pressed in this GamePadState.

overload.summary: Determines whether specified input device buttons are pressed in this GamePadState.

parameters.parameter: Buttons to query. Specify a single button, or combine multiple buttons using a bitwise OR operation.

overload.returns: true if all specified buttons are pressed; false otherwise.
overload.remarks: For digital buttons (such as A , START , and right bumper) the return value indicates whether the button is pressed. For analog inputs (triggers and thumbsticks), the return value indicates whether the input exceeds dead zone values. For example, a trigger will not be reported as pressed until it is pulled about 12% of its full range. IsButtonDown always uses the default dead zone processing mode, GamePadDeadZone.IndependentAxes . If multiple buttons are specified (by combining them using the bitwise OR operator), then all must be pressed (or exceed dead zone values) in order for IsButtonDown to return true .

method.name: IsButtonUp
method.summary: Determines whether specified input device buttons are up (not pressed) in this GamePadState.

overload.summary: Determines whether specified input device buttons are up (not pressed) in this GamePadState.

parameters.parameter: Buttons to query. Specify a single button, or combine multiple buttons using a bitwise OR operation.

overload.returns: true if any specified buttons are up; false otherwise.
overload.remarks: For digital buttons (such as A , START , and right bumper) the return value indicates whether the button is up (not pressed). For analog inputs (triggers and thumbsticks), the return value indicates whether the input exceeds dead zone values. For example, a trigger will be reported as not pressed until it is pulled about 12% of its full range. IsButtonUp always uses the default dead zone processing mode, GamePadDeadZone.IndependentAxes . If multiple buttons are specified (by combining them using the bitwise OR operator), IsButtonUp returns true if any of the specified buttons are not pressed (or do not exceed dead zone values).
